node_schema.node_extension_rule: published chain nodes are immutable; new semantics use a new chain_version or a new operator on an existing node slot

base_node_schema.debug_subscription_rule: read-only observation; must not alter business result or control decision
base_node_schema.snapshot_subscription_rule: diagnostic only; snapshot must never become live runtime input
base_node_schema.statistics_rule: optional observability; must not enter decisions or payload
base_node_schema.business_logic_rule: BaseNode carries no business logic; behavior comes from registered operators

plugin_schema.closure_rule: plugin owns node-local typed closure only; runtime kernel remains the only orchestrator

wiring_schema.node_selection_rule: exactly one active_operator per node slot per compiled manifest
wiring_schema.edge_rule: edges are adjacent and fixed by chain_version

message_bus.failure_behavior: diagnostic error recorded; business path unchanged

completeness_gates.name: v3_resource_coverage
completeness_gates.rule: all 103 v3 resources classified with axis and operator_kind

completeness_gates.name: feature_operator_mapping
completeness_gates.rule: every v3 feature maps to >=1 operator; zero GAP

completeness_gates.name: axis_boundary_machine_checkable
completeness_gates.rule: control/data/diagnostic invariants enforced by red tests

completeness_gates.name: manifest_selects_active_operator
completeness_gates.rule: compiled operator manifest selects exactly one active operator per node+scope

completeness_gates.name: node_immutability
completeness_gates.rule: published chain nodes cannot be inserted/reordered/renumbered

completeness_gates.name: plugin_closure
completeness_gates.rule: plugins own node-local closure only; no second lifecycle

completeness_gates.name: bus_not_decision_plane
completeness_gates.rule: subscribers cannot mutate control decisions or business outcome

completeness_gates.name: control_center_scope
completeness_gates.rule: register/consume/release isolated per scope; payload reconstruction forbidden

completeness_gates.name: control_record_required
completeness_gates.rule: every control_in/control_out writes an immutable ControlRecord; missing record fails

completeness_gates.name: debug_subscription_read_only
completeness_gates.rule: debug subscribers cannot mutate execution or decisions

completeness_gates.name: snapshot_subscription_diagnostic
completeness_gates.rule: node snapshots never enter live runtime input

completeness_gates.name: statistics_observability_only
completeness_gates.rule: statistics cannot affect decisions, payload, or business truth
